note: Pre-registered 2026-10-29 before any variant was run. Add new ideas at the bottom with a date; never delete a failed one.

variants.name: baseline
variants.idea: config.json as is: ORB + VWAP reclaim, 3R fixed target, Nifty green-day filter

variants.name: target_2r
variants.idea: closer 2R target (hit more often); min net R:R relaxed to 1.2 or nothing passes

variants.name: breakeven_1r
variants.idea: move the stop to entry once price reaches +1R

variants.name: trail_1r
variants.idea: after +1R, trail the stop 1R below the high; 3R target kept

variants.name: let_run
variants.idea: 5R target, trail 1R below the high after +1.5R: cut losers, let winners run to the close

variants.name: rs_filter
variants.idea: only stocks at least 0.5% stronger than the Nifty since the open

variants.name: orb_30m
variants.idea: 30-minute opening range instead of 15 (fewer, cleaner breakouts)

variants.name: orb_low_stop
variants.idea: stop at the range low instead of the midpoint (fewer whipsaws, smaller size)

variants.name: trail_plus_rs
variants.idea: the two most plausible ideas a priori, together: trail_1r + rs_filter
